column1: # It Takes Two (Hazelight / Electronic Arts), Unreal Engine 4 with Nintendo's NVN RHI, Switch version 1.0.2.
# The single 10 GB RomFS pak is an Unreal version 11 pak whose index holds no shader code archive: the
# shaders are inline in the cooked packages (Oodle) beside Engine/GlobalShaderCache-GLSL_SWITCH.bin.
# Started from the NSP script's provisional profile (nxnative/dm/games/profile_guess.py). Format: see
# Load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk* (NintendoSDK_movie), sdk.
# 60 fps: the Switch build is capped at 30; the host writes its frame limit and present interval for
# DM_FPS_TARGET=60. The game also runs at 30 (the Switch's own rate) when the target is 30.
# The NPDM declares 80 MB of system resource (virtual address memory). Unreal's nninitStartup reserves
# a 62 GB region and FMallocBinned3 takes 37 GB of it; the host gives it the 64 GB alias region.
# 256 MB stacks, 256 MB heap region, 3285 MiB application pool (the 4 GB Switch's pool).
# The engine's global shader cache and the game's material shaders, the latter inline in the cooked
# packages of Nuts-Switch.pak (porter/ue_inline.py reads the FShaderMapResourceCode records).
